en: Sepia-toned interior view of an ornate hunting or trophy room. Against a high, curtained wall stand two richly carved cabinets with their doors open, displaying elaborate glass and decorative objects. Above each cabinet is a mounted stag head with antlers. In the center is a small table with a mounted bird (a capercaillie). On the floor before the left cabinet is a single antler, and in front of the right cabinet is a pair of intertwined antlers or skulls. At the bottom of the image there are printed German captions identifying the objects.
